name: Calendar & Mail
description: Your calendar and email, through the Mac's own Calendar and Mail apps, with every account added there. Garth writes email drafts; you send them.
author: Garth
prompt: For the user's calendar use calendar_events and calendar_add_event; for email use mail_search, mail_read and mail_draft (drafts only: the user sends). They use the calendar and email the user connected (a Google or Microsoft account, or the Mac's Calendar and Mail apps): don't ask the user to set up a connector for Google Calendar, Gmail or Outlook. If a tool says nothing is connected, tell the user how to connect.
